# JuliaExport

Source: [`Kernel/JuliaExport.wl`](../../Kernel/JuliaExport.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#juliaexport-kerneljuliaexportwl--exportjulia)

ExportJulia: write the Adimensional stage, at one integer space dimension, as a FlowRG equations file (~/Physics/Sources/FlowRG.jl/docs/equations-interface.md): COUPLINGS, ETAS, SHAPES, MUST\_FIX, betal, betanl, etaMl, etaMnl, etabl, etabnl, with positional arguments; plus causal\_poles (design/CAUSALITY.md), an extra definition FlowRG does not call. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "JuliaExport".

## Symbols

### `ExportJulia`

`ExportJulia[adim, "Dimension" -> d, "File" -> path]` writes the FlowRG equations file for space dimension d and returns its path. "Form" -> "Compact" (default: dimensionless atoms as local variables) or "Explicit". Shape derivatives are written Darmh(aq^2), D2armh(aq^2). causal\_poles(couplings..., aq) gives the causal-pole conditions: each entry must be > 0 at every aq.

### `JuliaParts`

`JuliaParts[adim, d]` gives the parts of the equations file at dimension d (Mathematica expressions, shapes and atoms still symbolic): &lt;\|"betal" -> ..., "betanl" -> ..., ...\|>, as ExportJulia writes them.
